import os,glob,re,json
d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n')
G={}
for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
    k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
    rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
    if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
        G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]

def transform(g):
    g=[r[:] for r in g]; h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    # key bar: the small multi-color block; find rows where a color appears in a full-height vertical run of small extent
    # find connected components
    import sys
    seen=set(); comps=[]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if g[i][j] and (i,j) not in seen:
                c=g[i][j]; st=[(i,j)]; cells=[]
                while st:
                    a,b=st.pop()
                    if (a,b) in seen or not(0<=a<h and 0<=b<w) or g[a][b]!=c: continue
                    seen.add((a,b)); cells.append((a,b))
                    st+=[(a+1,b),(a-1,b),(a,b+1),(a,b-1)]
                comps.append((c,cells))
    comps.sort(key=lambda x:(min(i for i,_ in x[1]),min(j for _,j in x[1])))
    bar=[x for x in comps if len(x[1])<=len(set(x[1])) and len(set(j for _,j in x[1]))>1 and len(set(i for i,_ in x[1]))<=3]
    # simpler: bar = component with few cells but multiple colors? comps are single-color; group by adjacency
    # bar: columns of constant color stacked vertically, small; detect as components whose height < width or cells<= small and distinct columns adjacent
    key=None; shapes=[x for x in comps if x not in bar]
    # identify bar: smallest-area components clustered; instead: components with <=5 cells
    small=[x for x in comps if len(x[1])<=5]
    # group small components that share rows (vertical bar of colors)
    # assume all small comps form the bar
    keycols={}
    for c,cells in small:
        for i,j in cells: keycols[j]=c
    order=sorted(keycols)  # left to right
    keycolors=[keycols[j] for j in order]
    # shapes: components not in bar
    shapes=[x for x in comps if x not in small]
    # group shapes by color
    from collections import defaultdict
    bycol=defaultdict(list)
    for c,cells in shapes: bycol[c].append(cells)
    present={}
    for c,cs in bycol.items():
        cells=[p for cc in cs for p in cc]
        present[c]=cells
    # take one shape as template (all identical): use the one whose color is in keycolors
    tmpl=None; tmplpos=None
    for idx,kc in enumerate(keycolors):
        if kc in present:
            tmpl=present[kc]; tmplpos=idx
    ti=[i for i,_ in tmpl]; tj=[j for _,j in tmpl]
    hgt=max(ti)-min(ti)+1; top=min(ti); lft=min(tj)
    norm=[(i-top,j-lft) for i,j in tmpl]
    # stack: shape for keycolors[p] occupies rows top-(tmplpos-p)*hgt .. +hgt-1
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    # clear? existing shapes stay; add missing
    for p,kc in enumerate(keycolors):
        r0=top-(tmplpos-p)*hgt
        if kc in present: continue
        for (di,dj) in norm:
            i,j=r0+di,lft+dj
            if 0<=i<h and 0<=j<w: out[i][j]=kc
    return out

for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2']:
    print(k, transform(G[k+' input'])==G[k+' output'])
print(json.dumps(transform(G['Test input'])))

from collections import defaultdict
def transform(g):
    g=[r[:] for r in g]; h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    seen=set(); comps=[]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if g[i][j] and (i,j) not in seen:
                c=g[i][j]; st=[(i,j)]; cells=[]
                while st:
                    a,b=st.pop()
                    if (a,b) in seen or not(0<=a<h and 0<=b<w) or g[a][b]!=c: continue
                    seen.add((a,b)); cells.append((a,b))
                    st+=[(a+1,b),(a-1,b),(a,b+1),(a,b-1)]
                comps.append((c,cells))
    small=[x for x in comps if len(x[1])<=5]
    rowsig=lambda cells:(min(i for i,_ in cells),max(i for i,_ in cells))
    # bar: small comps sharing the same row signature
    sigcount=defaultdict(list)
    for c,cells in small: sigcount[rowsig(cells)].append((c,cells))
    bar_sig,barmembers=max(sigcount.items(),key=lambda kv:len(kv[1]))
    bar=[x for x in small if rowsig(x[1])==bar_sig]
    keycols={}
    for c,cells in bar:
        for i,j in cells: keycols[j]=c
    keycolors=[keycols[j] for j in sorted(keycols)]
    shapes=[x for x in comps if x not in small]
    present=defaultdict(list)
    for c,cells in shapes: present[c]+=cells
    tmplpos=None
    for idx,kc in enumerate(keycolors):
        if kc in present: tmplpos=idx; tmpl=present[kc]
    top=min(i for i,_ in tmpl); lft=min(j for _,j in tmpl)
    hgt=max(i for i,_ in tmpl)-top+1
    norm=[(i-top,j-lft) for i,j in tmpl]
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    for p,kc in enumerate(keycolors):
        if kc in present: continue
        r0=top-(tmplpos-p)*hgt
        for di,dj in norm:
            i,j=r0+di,lft+dj
            if 0<=i<h and 0<=j<w: out[i][j]=kc
    return out

def transform(g):
    g=[r[:] for r in g]; h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    seen=set(); comps=[]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if g[i][j] and (i,j) not in seen:
                c=g[i][j]; st=[(i,j)]; cells=[]
                while st:
                    a,b=st.pop()
                    if (a,b) in seen or not(0<=a<h and 0<=b<w) or g[a][b]!=c: continue
                    seen.add((a,b)); cells.append((a,b))
                    st+=[(a+1,b),(a-1,b),(a,b+1),(a,b-1)]
                comps.append((c,cells))
    rowsig=lambda cells:(min(i for i,_ in cells),max(i for i,_ in cells))
    sigcount=defaultdict(list)
    for c,cells in comps:
        if len(cells)<=5: sigcount[rowsig(cells)].append((c,cells))
    bar_sig,_=max(sigcount.items(),key=lambda kv:len(kv[1]))
    bar=[(c,cells) for c,cells in comps if len(cells)<=5 and rowsig(cells)==bar_sig]
    shapes=[x for x in comps if x not in bar]
    keycols={}
    for c,cells in bar:
        for i,j in cells: keycols[j]=c
    keycolors=[keycols[j] for j in sorted(keycols)]
    present=defaultdict(list)
    for c,cells in shapes: present[c]+=cells
    tmplpos=tmpl=None
    for idx,kc in enumerate(keycolors):
        if kc in present: tmplpos=idx; tmpl=present[kc]
    top=min(i for i,_ in tmpl); lft=min(j for _,j in tmpl)
    hgt=max(i for i,_ in tmpl)-top+1
    norm=[(i-top,j-lft) for i,j in tmpl]
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    for p,kc in enumerate(keycolors):
        if kc in present: continue
        r0=top-(tmplpos-p)*hgt
        for di,dj in norm:
            i,j=r0+di,lft+dj
            if 0<=i<h and 0<=j<w: out[i][j]=kc
    return out
